final: WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE share > value
